changelog:
Closing the picture-in-picture window no longer leaves a black screen.

WHAT CHANGED

- If you closed the small picture-in-picture window and then opened the app again, it showed a black screen. Now it opens on the list you were browsing.
- The same applies when a recording takes over the stream from full screen, and when the phone has closed the app in the background and you come back to it.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.6.6: a live channel no longer stops when its audio carries a damaged frame header.
